2609.20815.title: ERCPMP-Gx: Endoscopic Image and Video Dataset for Morphological, Histopathological, and Genomic Characterization of Colorectal Polyposis
2609.20815.paper_summary: Hereditary polyposis syndromes can be precursor lesions to colorectal cancer and are associated with a broad spectrum of extracolonic tumors. Early identification and accurate classification of these syndromes are essential for timely diagnosis, individualized patient management, and targeted surveillance strategies for affected families. However, public endoscopic datasets are largely organized around the individual sporadic polyp, and none links the polyposis phenotype to histopathology and germline findings at the patient level. Here, we present ERCPMP-Gx, an endoscopic, histopathological, and genomic dataset developed to support the application of artificial intelligence (AI) in the recognition, characterization, and classification of colorectal polyposis. Most procedures were performed using the Olympus EVIS X1 system with white-light endoscopy (WLE), narrow-band imaging (NBI), magnifying NBI (M-NBI), and NBI with near focus modes, yielding 160 images and accompanying video clips. Approximately eighty percent of cases represent clinically and/or genetically confirmed hereditary polyposis syndromes (PG), including familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP), Peutz-Jeghers syndrome (PJS), juvenile polyposis syndrome (JPS), and ganglioneuroma syndrome (GNS), while the remaining twenty percent comprise non-hereditary polyps and polyp-mimicking lesions with overlapping morphological features (Non-PG), included to support differential classification. Each released record is linked, where available, to standardized endoscopic annotations, representative histopathology, and clinically reported germline findings, forming an AI-ready, patient-level annotation framework. The dataset is publicly accessible at Mendeley (https://doi.org/10.17632/nzyfc544bx.2). For the latest updates and further information, readers are referred to the DataBioX website: https://databiox.com.
2609.20815.paper_summary_zh: 遺傳性息肉症候群可能是結腸直腸癌的前驅病變，並與廣泛的腸外腫瘤相關聯。及早識別和準確分類這些症候群對於及時診斷、個性化病人管理以及針對受影響家庭的監測策略至關重要。然後，公共內視鏡數據集主要圍繞個別散發性息肉組織，而沒有將息肉症表型與患者層級的組織病理學和種系發現聯繫起來。在此，我們呈現ERCPMP-Gx，一個內視鏡、組織病理學和基因組數據集，旨在支持人工智慧（AI）在結腸直腸息肉的識別、特徵描述和分類中的應用。大多數程序使用奧林巴斯EVIS X1系統進行，配備白光內視鏡（WLE）、窄帶成像（NBI）、放大NBI（M-NBI）和近焦模式的NBI，產生160張圖像和伴隨的視頻片段。大約百分之八十的病例代表臨床和/或基因確認的遺傳性息肉症候群（PG），包括家族性腺瘤性息肉症（FAP）、Peutz-Jeghers症候群（PJS）、青少年息肉症候群（JPS）和神經節瘤症候群（GNS），而剩餘的百分之二十則包括非遺傳性息肉和具有重疊形態特徵的息肉模擬病變（Non-PG），以支持差異分類。每個發布的記錄都與標準化的內視鏡註釋、代表性的組織病理學和臨床報告的種系發現相連接，形成一個適合AI的患者層級註釋框架。該數據集可在Mendeley上公開訪問（https://doi.org/10.17632/nzyfc544bx.2）。有關最新更新和進一步信息，讀者可參考DataBioX網站：https://databiox.com。
